title: Unciv: free Civilization alternative
caption:
Civilization V costs $29.99. Unciv lets you build and rule your own empire for free 🏛️

✅ Found cities, research technologies and lead armies
✅ Big tech tree, diplomacy with rival civilizations, or all-out war
✅ Multiplayer with friends and mods you can download in the game
✅ No subscription, no paywall, no ads, 100% free

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux · Android
ℹ️ Unciv is a fan-made remake, not Civilization V and not made by Firaxis: simpler graphics, its own art. No iPhone version. Civ V's $29.99 is the one-time Steam price
